title: Kimi-VL Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计前沿多模态模型的数据来源、长 CoT、奖励反馈、agent 轨迹及发布边界的读者
one_line: Kimi-VL reports a mixed multimodal pipeline from human and model-generated SFT to Kimi k1.5 long-CoT filtering and ground-truth-centered RL, while releasing weights and inference material but not the training data, reward artifacts, agent environment, or audit records.
Kimi-VL 报告了从人工和模型生成 SFT、Kimi k1.5 长 CoT 筛选到以真值为中心的 RL 的混合多模态管线；其公开了权重和推理材料，但未公开训练数据、奖励工件、agent 环境或审计记录。
why: It separates a detailed frontier-model narrative from the missing source manifests, validator specifications, licenses, splits, decontamination evidence, and replayable environments that Track 12 readers need to assess reuse and auditability.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact frontier multimodal report that discloses the outline of data, feedback, long-CoT, RL, and agent-trajectory construction while withholding the artifacts required for independent reuse and audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Kimi-VL is a frontier vision-language model report whose reasoning-relevant data pipeline spans multimodal pre-training, instruction SFT, long chain-of-thought (CoT) activation, reinforcement learning (RL), and computer-use demonstrations. For an auditable reasoning-data atlas, the key issue is not whether the released model performs well, but which training objects and feedback interfaces are actually disclosed and reusable.

The report describes data categories and post-training mechanisms, while the official release provides model weights and inference/deployment material rather than a training-data release. This Card records that boundary: public weights and code are not evidence that the underlying data, reward system, agent environment, or audits are available.

Kimi-VL 是一份前沿视觉语言模型报告，其与推理相关的数据管线跨越多模态预训练、指令 SFT、长链式思维（CoT）激活、强化学习（RL）和计算机使用示范。对于可审计的推理数据图谱，关键不在于已发布模型的表现，而在于哪些训练对象和反馈接口真正被披露且可复用。

报告描述了数据类别和后训练机制，而官方发布提供的是模型权重及推理/部署材料，并非训练数据发布。本 Card 记录这一边界：公开的权重和代码不能证明底层数据、奖励系统、agent 环境或审计工件可获得。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report presents Kimi-VL as a MoE VLM with an instruction model and a thinking variant. Its reasoning-data contribution is a disclosed high-level recipe: mixed text and multimodal corpora; human-seeded and model-expanded instruction data; Kimi k1.5-generated long-CoT traces; reward-model and rule-based filtering; and RL driven by binary correctness relative to ground truth plus a length penalty.

The feedback contract is mixed. Human annotators rank and refine candidate responses for part of SFT; rule-based and model-based verification support rejection sampling; and RL uses a scalar binary correctness signal. The report also describes agent screenshots, actions, dense grounding, and continuous trajectories, but no corresponding public environment or trajectory release.

报告将 Kimi-VL 描述为带有指令模型和 thinking 变体的 MoE VLM。其与推理数据相关的贡献是一个已披露的高层配方：混合文本和多模态语料、人工种子与模型扩增的指令数据、由 Kimi k1.5 生成的长 CoT 轨迹、奖励模型和规则奖励筛选，以及以相对真值的二值正确性和长度惩罚驱动的 RL。

其反馈契约是混合的。部分 SFT 由人工标注者对候选响应排序和修订；规则与模型验证支持拒绝采样；RL 则使用标量二值正确性信号。报告还描述了 agent 截图、动作、密集 grounding 和连续轨迹，但没有相应的公开环境或轨迹发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
For pre-training, the paper names six multimodal categories: caption, interleaving, OCR, knowledge, video, and agent. It says the corpus mixes open-source and in-house data and undergoes filtering, synthesis, and deduplication, but it does not publish source manifests, item counts, mixture ratios, or licenses.

For non-reasoning instruction data, human annotators create a seed set, a seed model produces multiple candidate responses, and annotators rank and refine the highest-ranked response. For visual coding, visual reasoning, and math/science tasks, the paper says rejection sampling expands SFT data when rule-based or model-based verification is more suitable than human judgment.

For long-CoT data, the authors assemble multi-step QA with ground truth, sample multiple trajectories with Kimi k1.5 under curated reasoning prompts, then filter wrong chains using an off-the-shelf reward model and rule-based rewards. Long-CoT warmup is followed by an online policy mirror descent RL variant: a reward model gives binary correctness relative to ground truth and a length reward penalizes excessive output. Curriculum and prioritized sampling use difficulty labels and per-instance success rates.

For agent data, an internal platform runs virtual machines in bulk across Desktop, Mobile, and Web action spaces. Heuristics collect screenshot-action records that are processed into dense grounding and continuous trajectories; human annotators provide computer-use trajectories with synthesized CoT. The environment, task instances, action schema, trajectories, and logs are not released.

在预训练方面，论文列出六类多模态数据：caption、interleaving、OCR、knowledge、video 和 agent。论文称语料混合了开源和内部数据，并经过过滤、合成和去重，但没有发布来源清单、样本数量、混合比例或许可证。

对于非推理指令数据，人工标注者先创建种子集，seed model 生成多个候选响应，标注者再对最高排名响应进行排序和修订。对于视觉代码、视觉推理和数学/科学任务，论文称当规则或模型验证比人工判断更适合时，会以拒绝采样扩增 SFT 数据。

对于长 CoT 数据，作者汇集带有真值的多步 QA，在整理后的推理提示下用 Kimi k1.5 采样多条轨迹，再用现成奖励模型和规则奖励过滤错误链式思维。长 CoT warmup 后使用 online policy mirror descent 的 RL 变体：奖励模型依据相对真值给出二值正确性，长度奖励惩罚过长输出。curriculum 和 prioritized sampling 使用难度标签及单样本成功率。

对于 agent 数据，内部平台在 Desktop、Mobile 和 Web 行动空间中批量运行虚拟机。启发式方法收集截图-动作记录，再处理为密集 grounding 和连续轨迹；人工标注者提供带合成 CoT 的计算机使用轨迹。环境、任务实例、动作 schema、轨迹和日志均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv record identifies the work as Kimi-VL Technical Report (2025) and states that code and models are publicly accessible through the official repository. Its paper sections 2.4 and 3 describe the SFT, long-CoT, RL, and data-construction claims summarized here.

The official MoonshotAI/Kimi-VL repository lists inference, deployment, and fine-tuning integration information and links official weights. It labels the repository MIT. The official Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct and Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506 pages are published by Moonshot AI and label the weights MIT.

These sources verify a report, repository, and model-weight release. They do not verify a release of the training corpora, prompt/trace manifests, reward models, verification rules, RL logs, agent environment, trajectories, split definition, or decontamination audit.

官方 arXiv 记录 将该工作标识为 2025 年的 Kimi-VL Technical Report，并说明代码和模型可通过官方仓库获得。论文第 2.4 节和第 3 节描述了本 Card 总结的 SFT、长 CoT、RL 和数据构建主张。

官方 MoonshotAI/Kimi-VL 仓库 列出推理、部署和微调集成信息，并链接官方权重；仓库标为 MIT。官方 Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct 与 Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506 页面由 Moonshot AI 发布，且将权重标为 MIT。

这些来源验证了报告、仓库和模型权重发布；它们并不验证训练语料、prompt/轨迹清单、奖励模型、验证规则、RL 日志、agent 环境、轨迹、划分定义或去污染审计的发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the distinctive feature is not a claim of fully open training. It is the unusual amount of recipe-level disclosure in a frontier VLM report: it names data categories, describes human/model trace construction, identifies Kimi k1.5 as the long-CoT generator, specifies reward and length signals for RL, and outlines computer-use trajectory collection.

At the same time, the report leaves the operational objects behind those claims unavailable. That contrast makes it useful as a disclosure-ledger entry: readers can distinguish a described pipeline from a reusable release instead of treating model-weight availability as complete reproducibility.

对于本图谱，其显著之处不是“完整开源训练”的主张，而是一份前沿 VLM 报告所披露的配方层细节：它点明数据类别，描述人工/模型轨迹构建，确认 Kimi k1.5 是长 CoT 生成器，说明 RL 的奖励和长度信号，并概述计算机使用轨迹的收集。

与此同时，支撑这些主张的可操作工件仍不可获得。这一对比使其适合作为披露账本条目：读者可以区分“被描述的管线”和“可复用的发布”，而不会将模型权重可得性误认为完整可复现性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not publish source-level data manifests, counts, mixture ratios, licenses, annotation protocol, prompts, Kimi k1.5 checkpoint details, rollout counts, decoding parameters, retention yields, reward-model identity, reward rules, thresholds, calibration, or RL logs. Train/validation/test splits and a decontamination protocol are also not disclosed.

The agent component is described but not replayable from public materials: VM images, tasks, action schema, trajectories, execution logs, and construction code are absent. Therefore neither the data lineage nor feedback false-positive/false-negative behavior can be independently audited. MIT status for repository and model weights does not establish rights for the mixed training corpus or its derivatives.

报告没有发布源级数据清单、数量、混合比例、许可证、标注协议、提示词、Kimi k1.5 checkpoint 细节、rollout 数、解码参数、保留率、奖励模型身份、奖励规则、阈值、标定或 RL 日志。训练/验证/测试划分和去污染协议也未披露。

agent 组件虽被描述，却无法仅凭公开材料重放：VM 镜像、任务、动作 schema、轨迹、执行日志和构建代码均缺失。因此，数据谱系以及反馈的假阳性/假阴性行为均无法独立审计。仓库和模型权重的 MIT 状态不能证明混合训练语料或其衍生物的权利状态。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit claims made around a frontier multimodal release. It supports a concrete checklist: separate official weights and inference material from training-data availability; ask whether model and rule verifiers are identifiable and calibratable; require source, rights, split, and contamination evidence; and treat an agent-data description as non-reusable until its environment and trajectories are released.

The report can inform conceptual comparisons of SFT, long-CoT distillation, RL with verifiable outcomes, and agent training. It should not be used as a drop-in source of training data, reward models, RL recipes, or replayable agent trajectories.

可使用本 Card 审计围绕前沿多模态发布的主张。它提供一份具体清单：将官方权重和推理材料与训练数据可得性分开；询问模型和规则验证器是否可识别、可标定；要求来源、权利、划分和污染证据；并在环境和轨迹发布前，将 agent 数据描述视为不可复用。

该报告可用于概念层面对 SFT、长 CoT 蒸馏、带可验证结果的 RL 以及 agent 训练进行比较。它不应被当作可直接使用的训练数据、奖励模型、RL 配方或可重放 agent 轨迹来源。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read sections 2.4 and 3 together: the post-training objective is only interpretable alongside the stated SFT and long-CoT construction path.
  • Treat the reward contract as partially specified: binary correctness and length penalty are described, but the reward model, rule implementation, thresholds, and calibration are unknown.
  • Treat the MIT repository and weights as release facts only; they do not resolve data provenance, training reproducibility, agent replayability, or benchmark-leakage questions.

• 应将第 2.4 节与第 3 节一并阅读：只有结合所述 SFT 和长 CoT 构建路径，后训练目标才可被正确解释。
  • 奖励契约只能视为部分披露：论文描述了二值正确性和长度惩罚，但奖励模型、规则实现、阈值和标定仍为 unknown。
  • MIT 仓库和权重只能证明发布事实；它们不能解决数据来源、训练可复现性、agent 可重放性或基准泄漏问题。

Wrong CoT responses are filtered by model evaluation and rule-based rewards; RL centers on binary answer correctness relative to ground truth. Retention thresholds, exceptions, and failure logs are unknown.
Moonlight intermediate pre-training checkpoint reported to have processed 5.2T pure-text tokens; Kimi-VL combines MoonViT, an MLP projector, and an MoE language decoder.

Human seed data train a seed model for candidate-response generation; Kimi k1.5 generates long CoT under curated reasoning prompts; the report also describes internal synthesis pipelines.
